title: The watchdog's “waits for the owner” question: a blocker the session only reports (a locked screen, a service down) with the step scheduled or retried by itself is not the owner's action; a direct request to the owner still is
note: Live case: a result that said the computer is locked, so the message can't go now, and it is scheduled for 08:15, became an owner to-do “unlock the computer before 08:15 and send”. Texts are made up and neutral. locked-no-retry and code-no-ask: a reported obstacle with no step of the session's own stays the owner's (the true branch: a physical action, a login). Input = the language line + the end of the result, as the watchdog sends it (no open cards).

turns.input:
Owner's language: English.
At 08:15 the shop gets a question about the price and timing of a repair. Right now the computer is locked, and the chat app does not send from it.

- **Why:** the team looks for a backup option, the two other shops are silent.
- **Message:** the team's text unchanged, in your name, no signature. We have not written to them before.
- **Reply:** any reply, even a bot's, I pass to the team word for word and will not ask again.
- **Call:** not touching it. Around 13:40 the team decides on the 16:00 call and sends what to confirm.

- **Message:** the team's text unchanged, in your name, no signature.
- **Reply:** any reply, even a bot's, I pass to the team word for word.
